title: Pentagon records of UFO detections and the DoD's five observables

tellings.quote: well luckily the pentagon has hundreds of instances of optical radar and infrared detections of ufos and from those records the dod has laid out five observable properties that are very consistent among the ufo sightings

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the Pentagon holds hundreds of cases where UFOs were picked up by cameras, radar and heat-sensing infrared sensors. He says that from those records the US Department of Defense has set out five observable traits that show up again and again across the sightings, which would mean the military sees a consistent pattern rather than random reports.
